extracted.subtask_description: Extract structured records from the United States Patent Office 1877 alphabetical index, capturing invention title, patentee, patent number, issue date, monthly-volume reference, and Official Gazette reference for each entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries are arranged alphabetically by the invention or discovery name (header: 'Alphabetical list of inventions—Continued').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the invention title as the primary sort key when parsing; sections are broken across pages with continuations and occasional cross-references (e.g., 'See ...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention or discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Title or short name of the invention or discovery as listed (examples on the page: 'Toy', 'Tongs, Pipe-welding', 'Valve, Globe', 'Trunk-roller').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include general category plus specific type, hyphenation, and commas; sometimes includes 'See' cross-references. Preserve original punctuation and wording for accurate indexing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name of patentee
rubrics_metrics.description: Name(s) of the inventor(s) or patentee(s) associated with the invention (examples: 'E. P. Hasbrouck', 'J. H. Jenkins', 'L. Westinghouse').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Names may include initials, multiple inventors joined by 'and', and occasional firm names; retain order and punctuation as printed to preserve attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: No.
rubrics_metrics.description: Issued patent number as printed in the index (often comma-formatted groups like '197,127', '189,296').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat as the primary unique identifier for patent records; be aware of OCR or typographical artifacts (commas, stray characters).

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue date of the patent, shown with month and day and year in abbreviated form (examples: 'Nov. 13, 1877', 'Apr. 10, 1877', sometimes only a month or incomplete form like 'Oct.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates appear in varying formats and abbreviations; normalize to a consistent date format if needed, but preserve the original printed form as a source field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Numeric monthly-volume reference printed in the index (column header: 'Monthly volume').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents the monthly volume number for the Patent Office publication; values are numeric and may assist locating the full entry in monthly reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to the Official Gazette entry (column header: 'Official Gazette')—numeric/page-like references appear in this column.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a cross-reference to the Official Gazette; preserve the printed number(s) to enable lookup in Gazette issues.
